messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service=redwood-inference-api from v2.13 -> v2.14, canary=5% across us/* and ap-south. Release notes: https://internal/release/2.14 :rocket:
adele: Thanks — tagging ops for visibility. change-window is today 23:00-23:30 UTC?
sam: telemetry shows a small uptick in 502s for ap-south starting +90s into the canary, not huge but noticeable: https://telemetry/boards/502s?range=15m
ops_lead: I see ap-south spike to 1.8% error rate, baseline 0.2%. Can we pause 5% in ap-south and continue elsewhere?
mike: Are we able to partial-pin regionally? config supports region overrides, but need a quick rollback plan if it worsens.
adele: yes we can pin route for ap-south back to v2.13 while leaving rest of canary. who will run the pin?
carla: I'm available to execute. prepping command.
carla: ```
# pin region ap-south to v2.13
deployctl rollout region-pin --service redwood-inference-api --region ap-south --version v2.13 --reason "502 spike" --now
```
mike: :eyes: should we also throttle concurrency in ap-south while pinning?
ops_lead: good idea, set max_concurrency=50 for ap-south during investigation.
carla: running pin + throttle now.
deploy-bot: Action started: region-pin (ap-south) by carla at 1700001130.
deploy-bot: Throttle applied: ap-south max_concurrency=50.
carla: pin complete, rolling back ap-south to v2.13. monitoring...
sam: immediate drop in 502s to 0.3% — looks like the pin helped.
adele: great. we should hold the rest of the canary until post-mortem. proposing: pause global rollout and open a follow-up incident for root cause.
mike: Agreed. Recommendation: revert global canary increment and mark v2.14 as blocked for ap-south until fix.
carla: deploy-bot, can you pause the canary increments?
deploy-bot: Canary increments paused by system at 1700001150. Current traffic: global 5% but ap-south pinned to v2.13.
ops_lead: Next steps: collect logs from inference nodes in ap-south, share any anomalous kernel/hardware hints. I'll start an ops ticket.
adele: I'll update release notes with a known-issue entry and change the change-window note to reflect hold. Edit: added note to release doc and flagged PR for rollback justification.
carla: tagging @oncall-night for follow-through.
mike: One more ask — record the rollback command in the thread for audit: `deployctl rollback --service redwood-inference-api --version v2.13 --scope region:ap-south`
carla: copying that command into the ticket.
deploy-bot: Canary hold acknowledged. If anyone needs to fully rollback global canary, use `deployctl rollback --service redwood-inference-api --version v2.13 --scope global` — requires two approvals.
adele: thanks all. final: holdcall placed, ops ticket created, release notes updated, follow-up postmortem scheduled tomorrow 14:00 UTC. :handshake:
carla: :thumbsup: closing thread for now, will post updates in incident channel.
